metadata.source: Certified 2026 Glen Rock Fiscal Baseline & NJ Title 54

coreInequities.description: Glen Rock receives only $3.7M in state education funding on a $61.8M budget, requiring local homeowners to shoulder 88.6% of school costs.
With 90.5% of the tax burden on homeowners, any unexpected infrastructure cost immediately impacts residential tax bills.

presetScenarios.name: State Education Foundation Aid Reform
presetScenarios.description: Lobbying Trenton for equitable student transportation and special education reimbursement to lower local school levy by $4.2M.

presetScenarios.name: Regional Shared Services & Equipment Pooling
presetScenarios.description: Consolidating specialized DPW equipment and 911 dispatch with Bergen County to reduce municipal operating expenses.

policyRoadmap: Maintain strict adherence to the statutory 2% property tax levy cap.
Pursue competitive state and federal clean water infrastructure grants for Diamond Brook flood mitigation.
